execution.master_policy: fresh ROS master and ROS_HOME per package

counting_policy: Count each testcase once from build_isolated/<package>/test_results/<package>. Historical catkin aggregate totals could count the same XML through parent result roots and are not reused.
claim_boundary: All 154 package run_tests targets complete in per-package isolation and every declared JUnit testcase passes. Packages without declared tests prove only successful target completion. This does not prove 154 simultaneous runtime nodes, MORAI input compatibility, P7 rerun, or controller closed-loop acceptance.
